name: SAR trading v2.0
summary: This EA uses the Parabolic SAR indicator as its primary signal generator to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell entries. It enters long when SAR dots flip below price and enters short when SAR dots flip above price, with configurable parameters for SAR step and maximum. The EA manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the SAR values and ATR-based calculations.
summary_zh: 该EA使用抛物线SAR指标作为主要信号生成器来识别趋势方向并产生买卖信号。当SAR点翻转到价格下方时做多，当SAR点翻转到价格上方时做空，具有可配置的SAR步长和最大值参数。EA通过基于SAR值和ATR计算的止损止盈水平来管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于抛物线SAR（Stop and Reverse）指标的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件为：当SAR指标从价格上方翻转到下方时开多单，表示上升趋势开始；当SAR从价格下方翻转到上方时开空单，表示下降趋势开始。出场条件依赖SAR的反转信号以及预设的止损止盈比率，止损通常设置在SAR值附近或根据ATR动态计算。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式，具体取决于参数配置。资金管理方面，EA提供了风险百分比参数来控制每笔交易的风险敞口，但没有采用复杂的马丁格尔或网格策略。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on the Parabolic SAR (Stop and Reverse) indicator. Entry conditions are: open a long position when the SAR flips from above price to below price, signaling the start of an uptrend; open a short position when the SAR flips from below price to above price, signaling the start of a downtrend. Exit conditions rely on SAR reversal signals as well as preset stop loss and take profit ratios, with stops typically placed near the SAR value or dynamically calculated using ATR. Position sizing employs either fixed lots or an equity percentage-based approach depending on parameter configuration. Money management provides a risk percentage parameter to control exposure per trade, but does not employ complex Martingale or grid strategies. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for strongly trending markets, but in ranging or choppy markets it tends to generate frequent false signals leading to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: SAR_Step
parameters.description: SAR加速因子步长，控制SAR指标跟随价格的速度
parameters.description_en: SAR acceleration factor step, controls SAR follow speed

parameters.name: SAR_Maximum
parameters.description: SAR加速因子最大值，限制SAR指标的极限灵敏度
parameters.description_en: SAR acceleration factor maximum, limits SAR sensitivity

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示使用SAR值作为止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示使用SAR反转作为出场

parameters.name: RiskPercent
parameters.description: 每笔交易的风险百分比，用于动态仓位计算
parameters.description_en: Risk percentage per trade for dynamic position sizing

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，基于经典SAR指标，易于理解和验证
趋势行情中表现良好，能够捕捉较长的趋势波段
参数可配置性强，SAR步长和最大值可调整以适应不同市场
自带魔术编号管理，可多品种多EA并行运行不冲突
风险百分比参数提供了基本的资金管理框架
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic based on the classic SAR indicator, easy to understand and verify
Performs well in trending markets, capable of capturing long trend waves
Highly configurable parameters, SAR step and maximum can be adjusted for different markets
Built-in magic number management allows multiple EAs to run in parallel without conflicts
Risk percentage parameter provides a basic money management framework
cons: 震荡市中频繁产生虚假信号，导致连续小额亏损
SAR指标滞后性明显，入场时机偏晚，容易错过趋势初期利润
缺少趋势过滤器（如均线或ADX），在无明显趋势时仍会开仓
止损设置依赖SAR值，在波动剧烈时可能止损过宽导致单笔亏损过大
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下交易成本影响显著
cons_en: Frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive small losses
SAR indicator has noticeable lag, entries are delayed and may miss early trend profits
Lacks a trend filter (such as MA or ADX), opens positions even when there is no clear trend
Stop loss relies on SAR values, which can be too wide during high volatility causing large single-trade losses
No spread filter mechanism, trading costs significantly impact performance in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如EMA200或ADX），仅在趋势明确时才允许SAR信号入场，减少震荡市中的虚假交易
加入ATR动态仓位管理和止损计算，根据市场波动率自动调整风险敞口和止损距离
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (such as EMA200 or ADX) to only allow SAR signals when the trend is clear, reducing false trades in ranging markets
Implement ATR-based dynamic position sizing and stop loss calculation to automatically adjust risk exposure and stop distance based on market volatility

risk_points: 震荡行情中SAR反复翻转导致频繁进出场，累积交易成本和滑点损失较大
止损依赖SAR值时，在高波动品种上止损距离可能过宽，单笔亏损比例偏高
缺少最大连续亏损限制和日内最大回撤控制，极端行情下可能持续亏损
risk_points_en: SAR frequent reversals in ranging markets cause repeated entries and exits, accumulating significant transaction costs and slippage
When stops rely on SAR values, stop distance can be excessively wide on volatile instruments, leading to high single-trade loss ratios
No maximum consecutive loss limit or daily drawdown control, potentially sustaining losses during extreme market conditions
